name: Orbit Gallery
title: Orbit Gallery
description: A smooth, interactive photo gallery arranged in concentric rings with synchronized scrolling, dragging, hover and image expansion.
summary: Counter-rotating image rings surround a clear center. Scroll or drag to explore, select a photo to expand it, and customize the ring geometry and motion in the studio. A composited DOM renderer keeps images and controls accessible without requiring WebGL.
highlights: Concentric rings with alternating synchronized rotation
Inertial wheel and pointer dragging with smooth hover scaling
Selected images expand and return to their original ring position
Responsive geometry contained within the studio canvas
Live geometry controls and three coordinated motion presets
Keyboard navigation, focus restoration and reduced-motion support
anatomy: Concentric rings of semantic image buttons
Shared angular motion state and scoped GSAP animation lifecycle
Portaled Radix dialog for image expansion

physics.description: A single angular state drives every ring. GSAP quickTo eases scroll input and drag targets, and scoped tweens coordinate hover scaling and image expansion. The rings pause during image selection and retain their phase across customization.

accessibility.aria: Image buttons use meaningful labels. Repeated ring images are excluded from the tab sequence. The dialog traps focus and restores the selected trigger after closing.

keyboard.description: Move between the gallery region, the first-ring images and the pause control.
Open the focused image or activate the pause control.
Pause or resume rotation when the gallery region itself is focused.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Disables automatic rotation and image tilt, and makes manual navigation, hover and dialog changes immediate.

recommended: Visual discovery and immersive image collections
bestPractices: Supply high-resolution images with descriptive alt text.
Place the gallery inside a container with an explicit height.
Keep a centered heading in a sibling layer with pointer-events-none.
Adjust ring spacing and image size together to preserve breathing room.

props.name: items
props.description: Images with src and meaningful alt text.

props.name: ringCount
props.description: Number of concentric rings, clamped to 1–5.

props.name: radius
props.description: Inner radius at the 1600px design width, clamped to 220–550.

props.name: ringGap
props.description: Spacing between rings at the design width, clamped to 100–260.

props.name: imageSize
props.description: Thumbnail width at the design width, clamped to 40–160. Scales with the container.

props.name: imageAspectRatio
props.description: Width-to-height ratio, clamped to 0.5–1.5.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Image corner radius in pixels, clamped to 0–40.

props.name: speed
props.description: Automatic rotation in degrees per second, clamped to 0–18.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Enable automatic ring rotation.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse automatic rotation.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Ease automatic motion to a stop while the pointer is in the gallery.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum image tilt in degrees, clamped to 0–65.

props.name: inertia
props.description: Scroll and drag settling duration in seconds, clamped to 0.15–2.

props.name: hoverScale
props.description: Thumbnail scale on hover or keyboard focus, clamped to 1–1.4.

props.name: scrollSensitivity
props.description: Degrees of scroll rotation per pixel, clamped to 0.01–0.3.

props.name: dragSensitivity
props.description: Degrees of drag rotation per pixel, clamped to 0.05–0.6.

props.name: motionDuration
props.description: Opening and closing duration in seconds, clamped to 0.2–1.5.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the accessible pause and resume control.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the contained gallery stage.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the gallery region.

props.name: onReady
props.description: Called once when the gallery is measured and positioned. Does not require WebGL.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the selected image on opening, and null when closing begins.
